name: Documentation or research task
about: Define a bounded task with context, owned paths, and completion evidence.
title: "[Docs] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Outcome

What useful result should this task produce?

## Scope and context

List relevant requirements, decisions, sources, and files. The repository phase is documentation plus a mock-data 3D prototype in `web/` ([ADR 0002](../../docs/decisions/0002-mock-first-3d-web.md)); identify any later explicit authorization if the task goes beyond that scope (for example real-data acquisition).

## Decisions still open

Which data, technology, or product choices must remain proposals?

## Completion evidence

How will a reviewer verify the result? Do not refer to nonexistent build/test commands.

## Ownership and handoff

Who owns the task and which paths can they edit? What should the next contributor know?
